arcane-gate: Create two linked Large portals: one in a ground space you can see within 500 feet and one within 10 feet of you. Each portal has one open face; anything entering one open face exits the other as though the spaces were adjacent. The portals block sight, and you can use a Bonus Action to change which way their open faces point.
arcane-vigor: Spend one or two of your unexpended Hit Point Dice, roll them, and regain Hit Points equal to the total plus your spellcasting ability modifier. The rolled dice are expended. **Higher-Level Slots.** You can roll one additional Hit Point Die for each slot level above 2.
armor-of-agathys: Gain 5 Temporary Hit Points. While any of those Temporary Hit Points remain, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 Cold damage. The spell ends when you have no Temporary Hit Points. **Higher-Level Slots.** Both values increase by 5 for each slot level above 1.
arms-of-hadar: Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation from you makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn; on a success, it takes half damage. **Higher-Level Slots.** Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.
aura-of-purity: A 30-foot Emanation surrounds you. You and allies in it have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves made to avoid or end the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned conditions.
aura-of-vitality: A 30-foot Emanation surrounds you. When it appears and at the start of each of your turns for the duration, you can restore 2d6 Hit Points to one creature in the aura.
banishing-smite: The triggering hit deals an extra 5d10 Force damage. If it leaves the target with 50 Hit Points or fewer, the target makes a Charisma save; on a failure, it is transported to a harmless demiplane and is Incapacitated for the duration, then returns to its former space or the nearest open space.
beast-sense: Touch a willing Beast. For the duration, you can perceive through its senses while continuing to use your own, including any special senses the Beast possesses.
blade-ward: Until the spell ends, whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you, it subtracts 1d4 from that roll.
blinding-smite: The triggering hit deals an extra 3d8 Radiant damage and Blinds the target for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target makes a Constitution save, ending the spell on a success. **Higher-Level Slots.** Extra damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3.
circle-of-power: A 30-foot Emanation surrounds you. You and allies in it have Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects. If an affected creature succeeds on a save that would normally deal half damage, it instead takes no damage.
cloud-of-daggers: Fill a 5-foot Cube with spinning blades. A creature takes 4d4 Slashing damage when the Cube appears in its space, enters its space, ends a turn there, or moves into it, but only once per turn. On later turns, you can use a Magic action to teleport the Cube up to 30 feet. **Higher-Level Slots.** Damage increases by 2d4 per slot level above 2.
conjure-barrage: Spectral copies of the weapon or ammunition used to cast the spell sweep through a 60-foot Cone. Creatures you choose in the Cone make a Dexterity save, taking 5d8 Force damage on a failure or half on a success. **Higher-Level Slots.** Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3.
conjure-volley: Spectral weapons or ammunition rain through a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder centered at a point within range. Creatures you choose in it make a Dexterity save, taking 8d8 Force damage on a failure or half on a success.
cordon-of-arrows: Plant up to four nonmagical Arrows or Bolts in your space and designate creatures the spell should ignore. When another creature first enters or ends a turn within 30 feet, one piece flies at it; a failed Dexterity save deals 2d4 Piercing damage and destroys that ammunition. The spell ends when none remain. **Higher-Level Slots.** Affect two additional pieces per slot level above 2.
crown-of-madness: A Humanoid that fails a Wisdom save is Charmed and bears a spectral crown. Before moving on each turn, it must use its action to make a melee attack against a creature you choose if one is in reach; otherwise it acts normally. It repeats the save at each turn's end. On later turns, you must use a Magic action to maintain the spell.
crusaders-mantle: A 30-foot Emanation surrounds you. You and allies in it deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage whenever you hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike.
destructive-wave: Creatures you choose in a 30-foot Emanation make a Constitution save. On a failure, a creature takes 5d6 Thunder damage plus 5d6 Radiant or Necrotic damage, and falls Prone. On a success, it takes half damage without falling Prone.
elemental-weapon: Turn a nonmagical weapon into a magic weapon and choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. It gains +1 to attack rolls and deals an extra 1d4 damage of that type. **Higher-Level Slots.** A level 5-6 slot changes these bonuses to +2 and 2d4; a level 7+ slot changes them to +3 and 3d4.
feign-death: A willing creature you touch enters a state indistinguishable from death. It is Blinded and Incapacitated, has Speed 0, has Resistance to all damage except Psychic, and is immune to the Poisoned condition for the duration.
fount-of-moonlight: Moonlight surrounds you, shedding Bright Light for 20 feet and Dim Light for another 20. You gain Resistance to Radiant damage, and your melee hits deal 2d6 extra Radiant damage. After a visible creature within 60 feet damages you, you can use a Reaction to force a Constitution save; on a failure, it is Blinded until the end of your next turn.
friends: A Humanoid you can see makes a Wisdom save; on a failure, it is Charmed by you. It succeeds automatically if you are fighting it or used this spell on it within 24 hours. The spell ends if the target takes damage or you attack, deal damage, or force a save, and the target then knows you Charmed it.
grasping-vine: Create a vine on a surface and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet of it. A hit deals 4d8 Bludgeoning damage and pulls the target up to 30 feet; a Huge or smaller target is also Grappled. The vine holds one creature at a time, can release it freely, and can repeat the attack as a Bonus Action. **Higher-Level Slots.** It can grapple one additional creature per slot level above 4.
hail-of-thorns: The triggering ranged hit bursts into thorns. The target and every creature within 5 feet make a Dexterity save, taking 1d10 Piercing damage on a failure or half on a success. **Higher-Level Slots.** Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1.
hunger-of-hadar: Create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of supernatural Darkness and Difficult Terrain that no light can illuminate. Creatures fully inside are Blinded. A creature starting its turn there takes 2d6 Cold damage; one ending its turn there makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 Acid damage. **Higher-Level Slots.** Increase either the Cold or Acid damage by 1d6 per slot level above 3.
jallarzis-storm-of-radiance: Create a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high storm Cylinder. Creatures inside are Blinded and Deafened and can't cast spells with Verbal components. When the storm appears, or when a creature first enters or ends a turn there, it makes a Constitution save and takes 2d10 Radiant plus 2d10 Thunder damage on a failure, or half on a success, once per turn. **Higher-Level Slots.** Each damage type increases by 1d10 per slot level above 5.
lightning-arrow: The triggering ranged attack becomes lightning instead of applying its normal damage or effects. The target takes 4d8 Lightning damage on a hit or half on a miss; creatures within 10 feet then make a Dexterity save, taking 2d8 Lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. **Higher-Level Slots.** Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 per slot level above 3.
mind-sliver: One visible creature makes an Intelligence save. On a failure, it takes 1d6 Psychic damage and subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw before the end of your next turn. **Cantrip Upgrade.** Damage becomes 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11, and 4d6 at level 17.
power-word-fortify: Distribute 120 Temporary Hit Points among up to six creatures you can see within range.
staggering-smite: The triggering hit deals an extra 4d6 Psychic damage. The target makes a Wisdom save and is Stunned until the end of your next turn on a failure. **Higher-Level Slots.** Extra damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 4.
steel-wind-strike: Choose up to five creatures you can see within range and make a melee spell attack against each. A hit deals 6d10 Force damage. After the attacks, teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of one target.
summon-aberration: Summon an allied Aberrant Spirit in an open space you can see, choosing Beholderkin, Mind Flayer, or Slaad to determine its stat-block features. It shares your Initiative and acts immediately after you, follows verbal commands without requiring your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. **Higher-Level Slots.** The stat block uses the slot level as the spell level.
summon-beast: Summon an allied Bestial Spirit in an open space you can see, choosing Air, Land, or Water to determine its stat-block features. It shares your Initiative and acts immediately after you, follows verbal commands without requiring your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. **Higher-Level Slots.** The stat block uses the slot level as the spell level.
summon-celestial: Summon an allied Celestial Spirit in an open space you can see, choosing Avenger or Defender to determine its stat-block features. It shares your Initiative and acts immediately after you, follows verbal commands without requiring your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. **Higher-Level Slots.** The stat block uses the slot level as the spell level.
summon-construct: Summon an allied Construct Spirit in an open space you can see, choosing Clay, Metal, or Stone to determine its stat-block features. It shares your Initiative and acts immediately after you, follows verbal commands without requiring your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. **Higher-Level Slots.** The stat block uses the slot level as the spell level.
summon-elemental: Summon an allied Elemental Spirit in an open space you can see, choosing Air, Earth, Fire, or Water to determine its stat-block features. It shares your Initiative and acts immediately after you, follows verbal commands without requiring your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. **Higher-Level Slots.** The stat block uses the slot level as the spell level.
summon-fey: Summon an allied Fey Spirit in an open space you can see, choosing Fuming, Mirthful, or Tricksy to determine its stat-block features. It shares your Initiative and acts immediately after you, follows verbal commands without requiring your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. **Higher-Level Slots.** The stat block uses the slot level as the spell level.
summon-fiend: Summon an allied Fiendish Spirit in an open space you can see, choosing Demon, Devil, or Yugoloth to determine its stat-block features. It shares your Initiative and acts immediately after you, follows verbal commands without requiring your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. **Higher-Level Slots.** The stat block uses the slot level as the spell level.
summon-undead: Summon an allied Undead Spirit in an open space you can see, choosing Ghostly, Putrid, or Skeletal to determine its stat-block features. It shares your Initiative and acts immediately after you, follows verbal commands without requiring your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. **Higher-Level Slots.** The stat block uses the slot level as the spell level.
swift-quiver: When you cast the spell and as a Bonus Action on later turns, make two attacks with a weapon that fires Arrows or Bolts. The spell creates the required ammunition, which deals normal nonmagical ammunition damage and vanishes after each attack.
synaptic-static: Creatures in a 20-foot-radius Sphere make an Intelligence save, taking 8d6 Psychic damage on a failure or half on a success. A failed save also muddles the creature for 1 minute, causing it to subtract 1d6 from attack rolls, ability checks, and Constitution saves to maintain Concentration. It repeats the Intelligence save at each turn's end.
tashas-bubbling-cauldron: Conjure an immovable cauldron that produces a Common or Uncommon potion you choose. You or an ally can withdraw one copy as a Bonus Action, up to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum one); the spell ends after the last is removed. The vials vanish when consumed, and unused potions vanish when you cast this spell again.
telepathy: Create a telepathic link with a willing familiar creature anywhere on your plane. Until the spell ends or either of you leaves the plane, you can instantly exchange words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages, and the target understands their meaning.
thorn-whip: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet. On a hit, it takes 1d6 Piercing damage, and you can pull a Large or smaller target up to 10 feet toward you. **Cantrip Upgrade.** Damage becomes 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11, and 4d6 at level 17.
thunderclap: Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation from you makes a Constitution save, taking 1d6 Thunder damage on a failure. The sound is audible from 100 feet away. **Cantrip Upgrade.** Damage becomes 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11, and 4d6 at level 17.
thunderous-smite: The triggering melee hit deals an extra 2d6 Thunder damage and can be heard 300 feet away. A creature hit must make a Strength save or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked Prone. **Higher-Level Slots.** Extra damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.
toll-the-dead: One visible creature makes a Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 1d8 Necrotic damage, or 1d12 if it is missing any Hit Points. **Cantrip Upgrade.** Add one damage die at levels 5, 11, and 17.
witch-bolt: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 feet. On a hit, it takes 2d12 Lightning damage. On later turns, you can use a Bonus Action to deal 1d12 Lightning damage automatically, even if the initial attack missed. The spell ends if the target leaves range or gains Total Cover. **Higher-Level Slots.** Initial damage increases by 1d12 per slot level above 1.
word-of-radiance: Creatures you choose and can see in a 5-foot Emanation from you make a Constitution save, taking 1d6 Radiant damage on a failure. **Cantrip Upgrade.** Damage becomes 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11, and 4d6 at level 17.
wrathful-smite: The triggering hit deals an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage. The target makes a Wisdom save and is Frightened for the duration on a failure, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. **Higher-Level Slots.** Extra damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.
yolandes-regal-presence: A 10-foot Emanation surrounds you. When it enters a visible creature's space, or a visible creature enters it or ends a turn there, you can force a Wisdom save once per turn. On a failure, the creature takes 4d6 Psychic damage, falls Prone, and can be pushed up to 10 feet away; on a success, it takes half damage.
compelled-duel: Choose one creature you can see within range. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you and can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from you. The spell ends early if you attack another creature, cast a spell on another enemy, one of your allies damages the target, or you finish your turn more than 30 feet from the target.
